decisions.reason: As a home-page product closely tied to the core messaging business, its option value remains high and there is no negative signal to justify abandonment.
With its own page it shows continued commitment and high uncertainty, so the option is worth keeping open while its prospects resolve.
Although only mentioned, email-fax conversion serves regulated German users and retains low-cost option value, so it is kept until clearer results emerge.
Being close to the established offer reduces uncertainty but also lowers the cost of keeping this feature-like option open, so it is kept while integration is assessed.
Email sandbox threat protection addresses growing security needs, so its option value justifies keeping it despite limited visibility.
Multi-engine virus scanning is close to the core and still uncertain, so the low cost of keeping the option open argues for keeping it.
